AI Exam Generator Agent

Put raw questions or paste an entire exam text, and the AI agent formats it instantly.

The AI will automatically identify all 6 required question types, word banks, gaps, correct answers, and assign 1 mark per question.

✨ The AI agent will compose a balanced exam containing:
  • 1x MCQ (a, b, c, d)
  • 1x Bracket word correction
  • 1x Sentence rewrite
  • 1x 90-110 word paragraph topic
  • 1x True/False statement
  • 1x Passage fill-in with 5 words bank & 4 gaps (1 mark per gap)
  • 1x Audio Listening Passage (Speech Synthesis)

Install "Study with Mr Osama"

Run this app like a native mobile app on your iPhone or Android phone:

🍏 On iPhone / iPad (Safari):

1. Tap the Share button (box with upward arrow).

1. Tap the three dots menu (⋮) in the top-right.

2. Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
